summary: Erayak Power Solution Group Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K reporting that on May 28, 2026, it consummated a share subscription with Erayak International Limited. Under the terms, the subscriber purchased 45,000 Class B ordinary shares at $3.09 per share, for total consideration of $139,050, representing approximately 49.9% of the outstanding ordinary shares. The shares were issued on June 4, 2026. This is a routine private placement or directed share issuance to an affiliated entity, not a special situation. No tender offer, strategic review, or change of control is involved; it is a capital-raising transaction with no public market implications. This filing does not trigger a special-situations category.
